pre_text: You came to rescue me? I don't need to be rescued. I can take care of myself!
post_text: You injured my monsters! How dare you! You better walk me back to Westguard!

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Our kind has been deprived of political representation. That is why I stood up to represent our interests. What right does the Guild have to condemn our liberty!
post_text: Violence can not rule these lands forever. You will pay for your actions soon enough.

pre_text: I was arrested for supplying Capture Cards to anti-guild organizations. The Guild's monopoly over Capture Cards is the source of their tyranny.
post_text: For all you know, I am just a vicious criminal that you are supposed to arrest.

pre_text: You are not going any further.
post_text: Seth will not be so easy to defeat...

pre_text: Fight!
I know you are not the same as the rest of them. But I also know you are not one of us.
post_text: I do wish that you were one of us.
Here is the Cyclops recipe. It will evolve in to a Multiclops.

pre_text:
Boyd:
....
post_text:
Boyd:
I accept the defeat. I shall do as you wish.

pre_text: A long time ago, when I was ready to attack Olympia to overthrow the Guild, a breeder came and defeated me. Decades later, his offspring comes to do the same. Perhaps this is my fate...
post_text: Your father left for the Abyss years ago to find out why capture cards do not work there. If capture cards do not work, there will be no one in power. You have stopped us, it is now your destniy to follow him.

pre_text: The Guild supplied me with its most powerful monsters. You think you can stop me?
post_text: They must have supplied you with better ones! A dragon? That's not even fair.

pre_text:
Carmin:
Are you afraid of ghosts?
post_text:
Carmin:
Okay, apparently you are not afraid of ghosts at all. I was just playing around. It was fun to watch masculine breeders quail before my monsters.

pre_text:
Celeste:
You will regret coming here...
post_text:
Celeste:
If only I had time to train a few more monsters...

pre_text: Fight!
A covert operation? I don't know what you are talking about.
post_text: Go back and tell the Guild you found a little girl pretending to be a Ninja... because that's what I am! I take it as an honor that someone actually thought I was a real Ninja though!

pre_text:
Chiyo:
I'm not permitted to say anything.
post_text:
Chiyo:
I was just kidding, you know. I'm not on any mission. I wish I was, but ninjas are out of date these days. No one hires me!

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Stop right there!
post_text: You were ordered by the Guild to defeat me? I was ordered by them to prevent anyone from passing! Something fishy is going on here...

pre_text: Fight!
Stop training monsters? I don't remember pledging my obedience to the Guild. What authority does the Guild have over what I do?
post_text: You win. I will disband my group if that is what you wish. This does not mean I am giving in to the Guild though. I do this only because I honor the outcome of our duel.

pre_text:
Clematis:
Huh, a perfect guest for the occasion. Will you join my march towards Olympia? I will overthrow the Guild. It will be liberty's first victory in many years.
post_text:
Clematis:
Sure, my proposed methods are violent. But before you criticize me, think back on how many other breeders you have fought. Do you not call that violent?

pre_text:
Fionn:
Another breeder this deep in the dungeon? Let's see who is better, you or me!
post_text:
Fionn:
I accept the defeat. Please take this.

pre_text:
Fionn:
Hey! Remember me from the little cave near Corova? I see you are a full-fledged breeder now. Let's have a rematch for old time's sake!
post_text:
Fionn:
I accept the defeat. Take this recipe.

pre_text:
Conan:
Stop right there!
post_text:
Conan:
You will not get away with this... I beg you! Please stop!

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Fight!
Are you here to take my cats away from me?
post_text: What will happen to my cats if you take them away? Promise me no harm will be done!

pre_text: Don't stand in our way, fellow breeder!
post_text: This was the only way...

pre_text: Get out of my hunting grounds!
post_text: If only I had caught that Noko here yesterday... I never would have lost to you!!

pre_text:
Cyrus:
Get outta my huntin... oh, it's you again.
post_text:
Cyrus:
I wish you would just leave me alone...

pre_text:
Cyrus:
Hey, how are you?
post_text:
Cyrus:
I'll pack up and leave.

pre_text:
Cyrus:
You again!? What did I do now?
post_text:
Cyrus:
This is totally unfair!

pre_text:
Cyrus:
I knew you would come. You and I both know I don't do anything to harm other people. But I do like fighting good breeders, so let's get started!
post_text:
Cyrus:
I thought with my evolved cubs I would be able to finally defeat you. I give up! I'll pack up and leave now.

pre_text:
Cyrus:
.... I'll go away, but before that, let me see what kind of new monsters you've captured!
post_text:
Cyrus:
Your collection is awesome! Where did you find them all? Oh, don't tell me. I will figure it out for myself. See you again!

pre_text:
Cyrus:
Arrest me!? What do you mean by that?
post_text:
Cyrus:
I just wanted people to stay away form my hunting grounds...

pre_text:
Cyrus:
I must... defeat you!
post_text:
Cyrus:
They told me I could go free if I defeated you...

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Please be at least a little better than your colleagues. They didn't really put up much of a fight.
post_text: Your Guild can take their revenge on me if that pleases them. Someone, then, will take revenge on them for me. You'll see. It never ends.

pre_text: The guild is experimenting with poison gases in the Giant Mangal in hopes to exterminate all monsters that live within it. I can't let that happen.
post_text: You are making a terible mistake, siding with the Guild.

pre_text: You have a Dragon too? I found one near here a few days ago. Let's have a duel!
post_text: You're pretty good... I see that you are not a Licensed Breeder yet. Im headed to the City of Westguard up north of here. I'll give you this Gem, you can equip it when you are Licensed.

pre_text:
Enya:
Wait there! I final found you... I must defeat you...
post_text:
Enya:
What? You are going to attack the Guild? I thought you were on their side. I wish you had changed your mind earlier... I guess all I can say is... Good luck!

pre_text:
Enya:
Hey, fellow breeder! Up for a duel?
post_text:
Enya:
I lose again... You watch out next time!

pre_text:
Enya:
Oh, it's you again!
post_text:
Enya:
You should let me win sometimes.

pre_text:
Enya:
I have caught some new monsters. Let's see if you have made any progress!
post_text:
Enya:
I'm headed to the large forest to the west. I hear there are many rare monsters in that area.

pre_text:
Enya:
Oh, it's you again, fellow Dragon Master. I'm on a mission right now... but a quick duel won't hurt anybody right?
post_text:
Enya:
I always forget how good you are until you beat me. I am going to catch up soon enough though!

pre_text:
Enya:
There you are! I wanted to show you my Orochi!
post_text:
Enya:
Even an Orochi can't stop your monsters. If only I had more... Maybe I should return to Southern Alvalon to capture some more Nokos.

pre_text:
Enya:
I was on a mission to find Cyrus, but I let him go. He hasn't done anything wrong, you know... My monsters are ready for a fight though!
post_text:
Enya:
Apparently not ready enough to fight you! Why is it that I can never defeat you? Do I have some sort of weakness I don't know about?

pre_text:
Enya:
So they sent you... This will be the one time you won't be able to defeat me, I am fighting for a nobler cause.
post_text:
Enya:
Let me go... I cannot be arrested here. I know you have your doubts about the Guild. You and I have been working for the Guild for a long time now. Think of all that we've done. Nothing good. Give me the chance to do something right.

pre_text:
Enya:
I wish you could join us so that we wouldn't need to fight anymore.
post_text:
Enya:
This does not mean we are wrong and you are right!

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Fight!
Fight!
Fight!
Don't take this personally. I'm just doing my job.
post_text: Hmm...

pre_text: Fight!
Mysterious? What is?
post_text: Well that was fun!

pre_text: Archangel or Archdemon. Which would you choose?
post_text: The power of choice is now yours.

pre_text: I have nothing personal against you... but you must stop here.
post_text: The Guild has put a lot of money on your head. I now see why they did.

pre_text: Fight!
Stop right there! That's right, you are about to get robbed.
post_text: It was all Mazarine's idea. We figured it was quicker to rob rare monsters from other breeders than to catch wild ones.

pre_text: You are under arrest!
post_text: Impossible...

pre_text: Are you headed to Westguard? Let's see if you have what it takes!
post_text: I am hired by the Guild to test rookie breeders headed to Westguard. You have passed your initial test. Best of luck with your journey.

pre_text:
Giselle:
What are you doing! Have you gone mad!?
post_text:
Giselle:
You traitor...

pre_text: Fight!
If you join us to attack Olympia now, it will fall. If you refuse to join us, at least don't get in the way.
post_text: I realize you want to prevent Olympia from becoming a battle ground. Your father was the same. But I will say to you what I said to your father many years ago. Change cannot be brought about without a price.

pre_text: You are a Guild breeder? You have come to the wrong part of the island, my friend.
post_text: A breeder as powerful as you... why follow them?

pre_text:
Harald:
I knew your father would be alive... This day was supposed to come sooner.
post_text:
Harald:
The Guild was founded with the purest aspirations.  We wanted to bring peace to the island, just like you. When power corrupts you, my child will bring justice to you.

pre_text: Fight!

My assignment was to assist and protect a mission to eliminate all monsters in the Giant Mangal. Monsters in the wild do not come out to harm humans unless you intrude into their habitat. Why is there a need to eliminate them?
post_text: I am at fault too, for supporting the Guild for all this time. I know you are having doubts of your own. Be true to your heart.

pre_text:
Heloise:
I did not escape prison because I wanted freedom. I escaped because I owe it to the people to give them freedom. My will is set. This time, even you will not be able to stop me.
post_text:
Heloise:
You are going to have to tell them I fell off a cliff and perished. This cause will not stop here as long as breeders like you stand up for justice. Farewell.

pre_text:
Heloise:
I did not escape prison because I wanted freedom. I escaped because I owe it to the people to give them freedom. My will is set. This time, even you will not be able to stop me.
post_text:
Heloise:
You are going to have to tell them I fell off a cliff and perished. This cause will not stop here as long as breeders like you stand up for justice. Farewell.

pre_text:
Heloise:
I knew you would be sent to stop me... You are about to single-handedly put a stop to our cause, but somehow I have hope that it's for the better. I trust you to do the right thing.
post_text:
Heloise:
Here, you can arrest me now.

pre_text: Fight!

My people have lived in these woods for hundreds of years. The Guild has no right to drive us out of here under the guise of 'safety'. I do not wish to harm you, but I have no choice unless you turn away and leave quietly.
post_text: The fittest survive. You have defeated me so I will leave. But as long as I am alive, I will fight to bring justice to my people.

pre_text:
Iris:
You are calling me an outlaw? We gathered here so that we can live peacefully, away from the rest of civilization. Why do you come all this way and tell us to leave?
post_text:
Iris:
If our people living peacefully in the deepest, uncultivated part of the island is a problem for the Guild, we are left with no choice. Go back to your master and tell him to beware.

pre_text:
Iris:
Arrest me? For what? For claiming that the Guild had no right to drive me out of my homeland? Or for trying to find a peaceful place for my people to live? Answer me!
post_text:
Iris:
Perhaps you would not be doing what you do if your home was burnt down by the Guild. Open your eyes, fellow breeder.

pre_text: I have been wating for you.
post_text: Take this, it's the recipe for a Carnoraptor. You'll make a very good breeder, just like your father.

pre_text:
Ivo:
We meet again, young lad. Let's see if you are ready for your new challenge.
post_text:
Ivo:
Please accept this gift. Use it for a cause you belive in.

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Fight!
You came to take care of me? Well, let's see what you can do.
post_text: ... You win.

pre_text: I've seen you in Westguard before... Let's see if your Dragon is any good.
post_text: I give up. That was my first loss since I came to Westguard. You are good.

pre_text:
Jubal:
Huh? I wasn't attacking anybody! I have been challenging other breeders in duels, but that's different from attacking them. Well, you came all this way so why don't we have a duel again!
post_text:
Jubal:
You win. We've come a long way since that time we met near Westguard. Next time we meet, I'll win!

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Fight!
Huh, so I see I was too much for your colleagues so you were brought in? I hope you're as good as they say you are.
post_text: I accept the defeat. I didn't know the Guild still had breeders like you that can put up a real fight.

pre_text: A ray of light? It must have been my monsters using Life magic. Do you want to take a closer look?
post_text: Do not forget, evil creatures are powerful, but against life monsters, they don't stand a chance.

pre_text:
Kiku:
A ray of light? That must have been my Archangel.
post_text:
Kiku:
Very good. I shall take off now. We may meet again.

pre_text:
Kiku:
I see you have turned to the dark side...
post_text:
Kiku:
Well, at least you are not leading an army to invade cities. You just take on one breeder at a time by yourself, so no civillian casualties are suffered.

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Fight!
Yes, your Guild is right. I do have a Deep Whale, but I am not about to attack anybody. Do you want to see what it can do?
post_text: Wow, I didn't think my Deep Whale could have been defeated by a young man like you. You are indeed powerful.

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Fight!
Stop now!
post_text: Please go on!

pre_text: The Guild sent a rookie like you to defeat me? I take that as an insult!
post_text: You would make a good pirate. I will sail off to find another place to make a living. Yo, heave ho!

pre_text:
Leomaris:
You are going to stand in my way again?
post_text:
Leomaris:
We'll meet again, young man.

pre_text:
Leomaris:
This time, I work for a noble cause. It's very noble indeed, and I get paid for fighting Guild breeders like you. Well... what are we waiting for!
post_text:
Leomaris:
Okay, I will quit and take off. You don't have to worry about these guys anymore. They don't have any breeders left that can fight, and they have spent all their money to hire me.

pre_text:
Leomaris:
What? Yeah, sure I've sunk a ship or two in my life. I'm a pirate, you know.
post_text:
Leomaris:
Great pirates always get arrested. But just as we are about to be hanged, we elegantly escape. Take me away, but know that you are wasting your time.

pre_text: There you are! Thanks for coming! It's that Goblin. I tried to fight him with my monster, but I didn't stand a chance.
post_text: Wow, you have a Dragon? You must be the one everyone is talking about! You should ^#00FF00go back to town^^ so that you can ^#00FF00rest your monster^^. Remember, going back to town is pretty much the only way to recover your monsters' health.

pre_text:
Leslie:
A Dragon Overlord!!! Watch out now, this one won't be easy, even for your dragon! You may need to come back when you are more powerful.
post_text:
Leslie:
Look at that egg, lets make a yummy omelette! Wait.. is that a GOLDEN dragon egg? Those are extra rare!

pre_text:
Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!
post_text:
Leslie:
Nice job!

pre_text:
Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!

Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!
post_text:
Leslie:
Nice job!

pre_text:
Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!
post_text:
Leslie:
Nice job!

pre_text:
Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!

Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!
post_text:
Leslie:
Nice job!

pre_text:
Leslie:
A Dragon! Dundean is almost in sight... You have to defeat it!

Leslie:
There it is! It's a Dragon Overlord!
post_text:
Leslie:
Now people can get to Lorensia without going through the Igneous Passage!

pre_text:
Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!
post_text:
Leslie:
The Igneous Passage is right there!

pre_text:
Leslie:
That Dragon is the one blocking the passage. You have to defeat it!
post_text:
Leslie:
Let's go! We're almost there!

pre_text:
Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!
post_text:
Leslie:
Nice job!

pre_text:
Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!

Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!

Leslie:
It's a Dragon Overlord!
post_text:
Leslie:
Nice job!

pre_text:
Leslie:
That's not a normal monster... it must be a Spirit! When defeated, they can be summoned into battles to aid your monsters! Most dungeons and caves have spirits in them. You should seek them out!
post_text: [The spirit Resistance has joined the party! Summon it by tapping your hero in battle]

pre_text:
Leslie:
That's not a normal monster... it must be a Spirit! When defeated, they can be summoned into battles to aid your monsters! Most dungeons and caves have spirits in them. You should seek them out!
post_text: [The spirit Shenron has joined the party! Summon it by tapping your hero in battle]

pre_text: My monsters are hard as steel!
post_text: I won't tell you where I caught these.

pre_text:
Lulu:
Look what I got!
post_text:
Lulu:
Okay, well this time I'll share  my secret with you.

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Fight!

May:
...
post_text:
May:
This power is now yours.

pre_text:
May:
...
post_text:
May:
I play a vital role in the sequel... You were not supposed to defeat me...

pre_text: Fight!
Give me all of your monsters!
post_text: I guess we'll go back to catching wild monsters again...

pre_text:
Mazarine:
There's a bounty on me? Well, I'll take that as a compliment!
post_text:
Mazarine:
...

pre_text: You came to rescue me? I appreciate the concern, but I cannot let you take me back. I have found a cause greater than blind obedience to an authoritarian organization.
post_text: Please tell the Guild you have found my remains in the dungeon. I do not wish to return. Do not make me take part in the crime against my fellow citizens.

pre_text: Fight!

post_text: Take this with you.

pre_text:
Njord:
... I can not let you through.
post_text:
Njord:
...

pre_text: Let's see if you have what it takes to stop us. I hope you don't underestimate the power of justice.
post_text: Justice will prevail... Heloise, our leader, will not be so easy to handle.

pre_text: Is my monster dangerous? Well, see for yourself.
post_text: Given that you just defeated my dangerous monster, your monsters are at least just as dangerous. Makes total sense that my monsters are too dangerous for me but yours are perfectly fine.

pre_text:
Pacal:
Stop...
post_text:
Pascal:
The Guild has put a massive bounty on your head. All bounty hunters on this island will come after you. You won't last long...

pre_text: Explosives? Well, I do have a lot of Unhappy Birds in my lineup. I wasn't planning to blow anything up though!
post_text: Hehe, I could see why the Guild would freak out about this. I'll go and explain.

pre_text:
Rabi:
The guild has problems with my experiment? Why? This place is very far from the city. It won't harm anybody.
post_text:
Rabi:
Okay, you win. You have defeated all my monsters and I cannot possibly continue. I was only trying to trap the energy these monsters emit to create a self-propelling device. Do you realize how much time it took me to capture all these monsters!?

pre_text: Fight!
If you stand in the way, I will fight you.
post_text: I will keep fighting, our cause is not yet lost.

pre_text: Corova is yours.
post_text: To think that all of this started when I let you take those first quests here... I do hope its change for the better.

pre_text: Fight!
The Guild sent you here? What have I done to deserve this kind of treatment?
post_text: Be warned. The Guild will start to fear you as your power grows. I will leave these woods if that's what you want.

pre_text:
Ren:
...
post_text:
Ren:
Huh? What am I doing? I don't remember a single thing since I got that Dementor... Maybe I can't handle it. Here, I'll give this to you.

pre_text:
Ren:
Stop. This time, I will do my best to defeat you. Prove your worth to me.
post_text:
Ren:
Kai was planning to attack and overthrow the Guild in Olympia with a resistance force gathered by a breeder named Heloise. You are about to single handedly destory the plan. Perhaps it was fate. Perhaps change will come about in a different way.

pre_text: The Guild sent you to go after me? Let's see if you are up for the job!
post_text: I was protesting against the Guild's excavation mission that is destroying the eco system here... but I will accept this defeat and stop now.

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Ah, finally someone comes to visit me all the way out here.
post_text: I will turn myself in.

pre_text:
Robin:
Oh, it's you again. How unlucky of me.
post_text:
Robin:
Oh, darn. Back to prison again.

pre_text: You think you stand a chance against me? HADUOKEN!
post_text: What are you feeding to your monsters?

pre_text:
Ryu:
You guys never learn, do you? Let me remind you of what happens when you mess with me!
post_text:
Ryu:
I think you learned your lesson. I'll let you go now.

pre_text:
Seth:
Olympia will not fall so easily.
post_text:
Seth:
Why the sudden change of mind? I thought you were fighting agaist the rebels...

pre_text: A Guild Breeder are you? Let's see how well you handle a nightmare.
post_text: Finally, a Guild breeder that can put up a fight...

pre_text:
Shadow:
I wouldn't say that I escaped. They all fell asleep and I just walked away. You want me to show you what happened? I will show you your worst nightmare.
post_text:
Shadow:
How was your dream?

pre_text:
Shadow:
I cut a deal with the Guild. If I defeat you here, they will let me go free.
post_text:
Shadow:
This must be a nightmare...

pre_text: Fight!
Traitor... I will not let you touch my father!
post_text: I shall have my revenge one day...

pre_text: Fight!
Fight!
Fight!
You don't stand a chance against my Skull Crow!
post_text: You win. This belongs to you.

pre_text:
Urusula:
...
post_text:
Urusula:
Do as you wish.

pre_text: Hey, you got a minute?
post_text: I accept the defeat for now. Just wait a while, you! I will have my revenge once these boys evolve!

pre_text:
Wendy:
I didn't realize I was blocking off a major trade route. I just wanted to fight you again. Didn't I tell you I'd come see you once my wolves evolved? Well, here I am!
post_text:
Wendy:
I'll be back with more!

pre_text:
Wendy:
Howdy. Did you miss me?
post_text:
Wendy:
You beat me again, but I came all the way to the other side of the island just to fight you. I might as well keep at it. Be ready, you.

pre_text: Fight!
I am al-Rashid. I challenge the Guild's monopoly over Capture Cards. And I challenge you for standing by them.
post_text: I accept the defeat. If only potent breeders like yourself stood up against the Guild...

pre_text:
al-Rashid:
Hello there. So, you are the one sent to pick me up yet again. I will resist.
post_text:
al-Rashid:
Arresting me will not stop anything. The tide has already turned.
